result.topic_en: Calculations with Dedekind's operations +, − and the relation < on fraktur-letter objects (with [δ]). From the rule q + (x − y) = (q + x) − y he derives d = m + [δ], and then shows that the pair of conditions m+n < b < m, t = b − n is equivalent to n < t < m − n, b = t + m.
result.transcription:
Ist $\mathfrak{y} < \mathfrak{q}$, so ist $\mathfrak{q} + (\mathfrak{x} - \mathfrak{y}) = (\mathfrak{q}+\mathfrak{x}) - \mathfrak{y}$
$\mathfrak{y} = \mathfrak{a}_r$, $\mathfrak{q} = \mathfrak{m}$, $\mathfrak{x} = [\delta]$
$\mathfrak{m} + ([\delta] - \mathfrak{a}_r) = (\mathfrak{m} + [\delta]) - \mathfrak{a}_r$ hier $= \mathfrak{a}_r$
$[\delta] - \mathfrak{a}_r = \mathfrak{m}_r[\delta]$, wo $\mathfrak{m}_r = ([\delta], \mathfrak{a}_r)$
$\mathfrak{d} = \Sigma \mathfrak{a}_r = \mathfrak{m} + [\delta][\mathfrak{m}_1, \mathfrak{m}_2, \mathfrak{m}_3 \dots] = \mathfrak{m} + \mathfrak{m}[\delta]$
$= \mathfrak{m} + [\delta]$
$[\delta] =$ [-$\mathfrak{n}$-] $\mathfrak{n}$
Ist $\mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$, so ist $\mathfrak{m} + (\mathfrak{n} - \mathfrak{b}) = (\mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n}) - \mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{d} - \mathfrak{b}$
ist also
$\mathfrak{d} < \mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$, $\mathfrak{d} = \mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$
so ist
$\mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{m} + (\mathfrak{b} - \mathfrak{n})$ ; $\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b} - \mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{m} - \mathfrak{n}$
und umgekehrt, wenn
$\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b}' < \mathfrak{m} - \mathfrak{n}$,
[-so ist-] {+[?]+} so ist
$\mathfrak{b}' = \mathfrak{n} - (\mathfrak{b}' + \mathfrak{m})$ ; $\mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n} < (\mathfrak{b}'+\mathfrak{m} < \mathfrak{m}$

Aus $\mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$ [-folgt-] und $\mathfrak{t} = \mathfrak{b} - \mathfrak{n}$ folgt
$\mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{m} + \mathfrak{t}$ ; $\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{t} < \mathfrak{m} - \mathfrak{n}$
Und aus $\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{t} < \mathfrak{m} - \mathfrak{n}$ und $\mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{t} + \mathfrak{m}$ folgt
$\mathfrak{t} = \mathfrak{n} - \mathfrak{b}$ ; $\mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$

Also die Doppelannahme
$\mathfrak{m}+\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{b} < \mathfrak{m}$ , $\mathfrak{t} = \mathfrak{b} - \mathfrak{n}$
ist äquivalent mit der Doppelannahme
$\mathfrak{n} < \mathfrak{t} < \mathfrak{m} - \mathfrak{n}$ , $\mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{t} + \mathfrak{m}$

methods.what: Associativity-type rule linking + and − under the condition y < q
Expression of [δ] − a_r as a product, with m_r defined as a pair/gcd
Derivation that the sum d of the a_r equals m + [δ]
For b < m, m + (n − b) equals d − b
Equivalence of two pairs of conditions under the substitution t = b − n, b = t + m
